mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_credit_account(user_id) VALUES(#{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.select: SELECT user_id,balance,opening_balance,status,version FROM user_credit_account WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credit_account SET balance=balance+#{delta},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND balance+#{delta} >= 0
